# tplinkeasysmart_ports (Data Source)

Port settings and link state (Switching > Port Setting in the web UI). Read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplinkeasysmart_ports" "this" {}

output "linked_ports" {
  value = [for p in data.tplinkeasysmart_ports.this.ports : p.id if p.actual_speed != "link-down"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `switch` (String) Name of the switch (a key of the provider's `switches` map) this object lives on. Omit it to use the provider's own switch (`host`), or the only configured switch.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `ports`.
- `ports` (Attributes List) One entry per physical port. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Read-Only:

- `actual_flow_control` (Boolean) Negotiated flow control.
- `actual_speed` (String) Negotiated speed, or link-down.
- `configured_flow_control` (Boolean) Configured flow control.
- `configured_speed` (String) auto, 10Mbps-half, 10Mbps-full, 100Mbps-half, 100Mbps-full or 1000Mbps-full.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Administrative state.
- `id` (Number) Port number (1-based).
- `lag` (Number) LAG group the port belongs to, 0 if none.
